column3: Secret Missions: optional finds by reported chapter. Right toggles checkmarks in the list; OK opens details and Check/Uncheck toggles status. Progress saves on SD. Chapter gates marked ? are uncertain.
Safe & Door Codes: browse published numeric codes and passwords by type. [?] marks less-corroborated, conflicting or potentially changing reports. Ordinary robbery safes often have a random code.

Bridges, Cars, Stunts and Collections: each listed entry can be marked Completed. Right toggles a checkmark in its list; OK opens details, with Check/Undo at center. Progress saves to SD and reloads automatically.

Press Right (Emulate) to start the best map or link immediately. GTA6GPS maps come first. Press OK during NFC to browse multiple links, then Up/Down and OK to select. Tap your unlocked phone. Back stops NFC and returns to the checklist with the item highlighted.

Under the Bridge and Stunt Jumps are grouped by county in Collections; Knife Flights and Base Jumps are there too (397 stunts total). Cars include Randy, Moses, Wyman and Standout Vehicles. Collections include cards, scans, flamingos and other finds. Any 300 stunts count toward 100%. A single successful bridge pass or stunt jump gives completion credit; map-icon bonus objectives are optional. Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots: purple = found, white = completed. PowerPyx reports Lapwing Mallard fits all bridges; try night hours 22:00–05:00 for lighter road traffic. Remain airborne, avoid touching water/structure. 250 stunts for trophy; 300 for 100%. Bridge route numbers are guide order, not game IDs.
Standout roster additions (reported variants, tracked IDs 5222-5238):
Lagoon Schafter: Ocean Beach container; Street Racer; speed 7.6, acceleration 7.5, handling 4.5. Separate from Nightlight.
Burning Cypher: Port Gellhorn container; Stock Car; speed 8, acceleration 8.3, handling 5.2. Separate from Bareback and Pop Art.
Status RSX: Gellhorn Raceway recovery truck; Stock Car; speed 8.7, acceleration 8.7, handling 7; reported registration $40,650, sale $10,655.
Highwayman Sanchez: Billy robbery story bike; Race Bikes; retention not verified.
Smokescreen Carbon RS: Port Gellhorn building-site container; Race Bikes; speed 7, acceleration 8, handling 7.6. Not Hung Carbon RS.
Bullion Gauntlet: Millport cargo container; Ripped & Shredded.
Beast Chino: Lake Tallaloko luxury resort; Retro; exact parking spot not verified.
Dogfight FCR: VCIA flight school; Retro; aviation styling, not Booty FCR 1000.
Obsidian Sovereign: Draper Island shipping container; Retro; not Peacock or Blood Fever.
Raul's Coquette Classic: Ocean Beach marina; Retro; distinct from ordinary 1964 Coquette in published variant lists.
AudaCity Sanchez: Chapter 3 Trial by Tire, La Perle parking garage; use during mission, retention not verified.
AudaCity Sandking: Chapter 3 Quit Your Job, Sell Your House; after hospital drop-off keep or sell. Alternate Vice City Sign stunt: Key Cloner, alarm, no tracker. Reported registration $4,400.
Interdimensional Youga: Abandoned in Mount Kalaga National Park; Fine Art; separate from Third Eye at Grayson.
Lacewing Maverick: Crosstown rooftop; Law & Order; exact roof access not verified.
Independence Boomazoom: Bar by Lake Leonida; Americana-style livery (Unconfirmed).
Sandblasted Cliffhanger: Breakwater Quarry container corroborated by GTABase and GTA Town; All-Terrain; distinct from Magma.
Chrome Street Blazer: Roadside cargo crate, Port Gellhorn; All-Terrain; distinct from Azalea and Tormentor.
Basketball: the illustrated route documents four Hamlet Prison hoops (two per yard), two Washington Beach roof hoops, three on an Ocean Beach roof and two four-hoop underpass clusters. Score each hoop separately. Some GPS-to-route numbers remain unmatched.

Destroy cocaine flamingos with black-and-white beaks. Black-and-yellow beaks are decorative; loose cocaine is optional. Destroy 100 of the reported 125 figures for 100% completion. Use Focus if unsure which figure can be destroyed.

Scan hair, makeup and tattoo magazines with WAiNK; pick up watches directly. Discover 70 of the reported 79 styles for 100% completion. Collecting 10 watches reportedly unlocks Move Time Forward; 20 unlocks Pause Time of Day.

After a magazine scan, visit the appropriate character's salon or tattoo studio. Hair appears under Magazine Styles; tattoos appear under Awards for the relevant body part. Discovery credit does not reportedly require purchasing the style. Watches appear under wardrobe Accessories > Watches. Jason can reportedly scan Sunset Blush for Lucia. A paired tattoo magazine may unlock both characters' designs.

Tattoo studios appear under Map > Style > Tattoos. Stock varies by studio; Electric Fang in Stockyard requires the Ultimate Edition. A red line under a design may indicate bank-account payment. Missed gang-operation watches may reappear on a later visit. Check the collection counter after each pickup.

Diving: Island Dreams unlocks diving. Bring scuba gear, choose the metal detector from lower-right weapon wheel, follow chest markers and dig once light turns GREEN. The nearby wrecks southeast of Key Lento can be visited together.

Optional Missions are listed in Collections; Cal and Kirk are also covered in Secret Missions. Messages in Bottles are optional reading and do not count toward the 34 books and swaps.

Meteorites: collect distinct fragments, then sell them to participating pawn shops or Kenton after unlocking his contact (reported). Shared cave and trench pins can lead to several pickups; the full fragment total is unconfirmed.

Strangers & Freaks: complete the reported eight qualifying strands: Merle (Final Flush), Freddie (Retest), Kirk (Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (Buddy?), Alvan (Missing Person), Yago (Brother to Brother), Papa Audacity (The Audacity), and Pilot Pete (last delivery). Credit is awarded at the strand finale; check the trophy counter. Shirley's errands, Yago's limited race, Shayna's ride, Yasmani's one-day ATM tip and optional Gold Blammer/small-bank jobs may be missable.

Stick Ups reportedly unlock after Girls' Trip (Chapter 2). Use Map > Robberies > Stick Ups to confirm eligible stores; complete 50 of 91 for 100%.

Missables: keep a manual save before Tourist Trap (C1) and Checking Out (C2). In C2 pay Linda before Slam Dunk, collect Starlet Motel cards and books, and help Wyman at his car before moving. In C3 take Gil's pistol in Safe Word and Monty's pistol in The Missing Link. Pete's rifle is a C4 mission pickup.

Chapter 2: finish Girl's Trip and start Take a Vehicle to Moses as Lucia. Keep the first registration unused. WAiNK-scan a candidate: tracker NONE, eligible and a free garage slot. Drive to Watkins Auto Parts, Port Gellhorn. Complete Moses' tutorial. If prompted, choose Find Another instead of spending the waiver on the tutorial car. Bring the car you want. Open Services (PS5: L2 then Square; Xbox: LT then X), Respray, then Register. Both first services should show FREE. Confirm ownership and check Scooter Bros.\n\nBison: reported 6 cargo slots; Dominator: 2. Montagne XL waits behind Watkins. Choose a useful cargo vehicle or save the waiver for a high-value car (see Free Thrax glitch). Subsequent registrations normally cost money; no reproducible unlimited free method established. Chapter 3 Pay 'n' Spray reportedly accepts Standard trackers after story unlock; Advanced tracker registration: complete Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, progress Randy's Wish List, finish Dale Mamba and receive Randy's call. Key Cloner alone is not enough. GTABase (Nov 24) corroborates the one-time free offer, and reports Advanced tracker registration in Chapter 4; check actual Randy progression and Register availability before relying on an earlier unlock.
Dispatch: select a region. OK checks or undoes the stop. Left (Next) advances to the next unchecked stop. Right (Emulate) opens the location reference when available. Back returns to the region menu.

61 reported cheat effects; 21 have published inputs. [?] means the input is unavailable. PS5 footage reportedly confirms $250,000, Unlimited Focus, Attack Force and HVY Bulldozer; Exploding Balls has a reported menu input. Xbox inputs include reported conversions and may differ. Videotape has conflicting Xbox inputs; Pinhole is not independently corroborated.

To use: finish the story and the individual cheat's unlock challenge. Check Progress > Cheats. In free roam press D-pad Up to open phone. Hold L1 and R1 (PS5) or LB and RB (Xbox), then enter the D-pad code.

Save before cheats: outlets report no saving or trophies/achievements once a cheat is active in that session. Story Mode only. A Nov 24 PS5 recording reportedly shows the $250,000 activation warning: saving and trophies are unavailable for that session. Keep a separate pre-cheat save; restart the game and load it before continuing normal progress.

Unverified codes are test sequences, not confirmed working GTA VI cheats. Matching cheat effects do not prove the inputs work. Xbox equivalents are controller-button conversions. Save before trying any code. TRI = Triangle; CIR = Circle; SQR = Square; U/D/L/R = directions.

Study any 100 of the reported 255 animals for 100% completion. Use binoculars and hold R1/RB when the study prompt appears. Aquatic species may be studied while swimming nearby; landing fish is a separate activity.

Fishing: buy lures from Ammu-Nation stores with a fish icon. F = freshwater; S = saltwater; s/M/L = small/medium/large; ? = unknown. Fish size and lure size are separate. D-pad Right changes lures. The Fish Log updates after a successful catch. Medium freshwater lure $45; medium saltwater $56; large saltwater $125, reportedly unlocked in Chapter 3.

Hunting pages list reported habitats and recommended weapons. Animals roam, so a map pin is a search area rather than a guaranteed spawn. Three mutant species are reported at Tortoise Head Power Plant, southeast of

Reported optional encounter (By Invitation Only); earliest story gate unconfirmed. Capri pavilion on Beacon Circle, by Bean Machine and gold-painted performer. If officer approaches, interrupt conversation until arrest, then surrender; alternatively bump performer, converse with officers, later surrender to Capri police. Cage escape prompt Square (PS5) / X (Xbox); recover cage keys, reclaim equipment and CPD Moreland 850 from open police-car trunk; free remaining prisoners.

Reference only; not additional checklist IDs.

Clock Out: after Day Release, Jason accepts Lucia's call; pick her up at community center by 16:00 in a vehicle, then drive home. Missable.

Donnie's Lost Drugs: after Swamped, dive southeast portion of search area north of Key Lento, open boat stern compartment and deliver to Brian for $1,200.

Impounded Vehicle: after Coffee Break, collect Lucia's car at Port Gellhorn police lot and clear two-star pursuit.

Get Your Wheels: after Dealer's Choice, recover one impounded car through Scooter Bros or register a replacement with a free garage slot.

Reference only; not additional checklist IDs.

It's a Date!: after Heavy Lifting, bring both characters to Courtyard Bar in Stockyard, buy a drink and exit; relationship benefit.

Bad Driver!: after Party Hard, finish before Power Play. Chase Felipe from Millport bar; killing reportedly pays $20,000, sparing unlocks a later car gift instead.

Dre'Quan's Gift: several days after Photo/Shoot, either character can collect KD's SFB 1000 from alley behind La Perle Pay n Spray.

Story safehouses unlock through the story. Published guides report no house purchases or passive-income businesses in Story Mode. Garages are purchasable; use the Vice City Real Estate phone app when unlocked. Eight purchasable garages cost $160,000 total. Check Garages for exact costs and storage. The Starlet Motel is temporary rented accommodation, not property ownership. Del Rio Boulevard is an additional free hidden garage unlocked via the Chapter 3 laptop and keypad; it is not one of the eight purchases.\nRandy’s post-Delivery Day Tempesta collection reportedly includes access to the one-slot Domestic Timbers garage in Balsero. See the Randy finale guide.

Pool: 17 tables are reported: 10 solo and 7 with opponents. Win at any 5 distinct opponent venues for 100%; beat all 7 for a reported tattoo. A story match that ends early is not necessarily an opponent win. Pool practice raises Focus. Sports challenges: Pool Streak is 3 venues in one day without a loss or quit; Triple Bank and 8-Ball Break are separate. Golf: complete two different mini-golf courses for 100%; Golf Pro requires the 18-hole King Gator and Frontier rounds in the same day at par or better. Full golf is separate. Tennis: courts are mapped, but a scored opponent match has not been established in the reviewed guides.

Chapter 3: finish Randy’s active wishlist, Dale Mamba and Mansion Thrax. Wait about a day for Randy’s call. Either character can meet him at the Balsero showroom. Escort him and protect the cars in the delivery mission. Reported reward: $25,000 and Supply & Demand trophy.
After his next text, retrieve Raul’s Tempesta from Domestic Timbers garage in Balsero; one garage slot, $11,600 reported registration, $27,150 reported resale in good condition.

Original board: 15 cars plus story Zorrusso (16 tracker entries). Mamba and Thrax are separate later missions; Coquette D10 is a reported later request. Cypher, Carbonizzare and Neon are crossed-out candidates in some sources. The app tracks 22 reported requests/sightings, not 22 mandatory deliveries. Talk to Randy for new hints; seven board spawns are tip-gated. Supply & Demand is awarded at Delivery Day, not simply upon the last board car.

After Island Dreams, complete the two initial sets and sell them to Kenton. Complete Check in with Kenton, then search and sell the next three sets. Maritime Dispute requires Chapter 3 Jason and prior Kenton progress; finish it to access the final two sites. Published thresholds differ. Use a scuba-equipped boat from Watson Bay or Capri.
Check Progress > Contacts > Kenton Rees > Shipwrecks Cleared. Purple chest markers show outstanding finds. Seven sets contain 41 relics; Del Ocio’s 10 Gold Doubloons are separate. For 100%, clear five of seven Kenton sets and all 33 Exploration discoveries. The five named treasure wrecks plus Del Ocio give six discovery entries; Belpoint Strait and Bobcat are reported treasure-only.
For a missing piece, open Progress > Collections > Kenton’s Treasures, select its named site and use the detector; buried chests must be pulled free and opened. Return to Island Dreams Boat Charters, focus on Kenton (L2/LT), select Treasures (Circle/B). Check BuckMe after any later buyer text; do not count counter payment twice.
Underwater: all 33 named locations have individual map references. Track Progress > Collections > Exploration > Points of Interest > Underwater Discoveries. Passenger Jet and Sailboat have mapped wreck evidence but no readable credit notification in the reviewed video.

Frampton Island: northeast of Lummox; hillside bunker keypad 3612. Bring a flashlight. Reward and connection to Final Flush are unverified.\nDecor District: warehouse north of Stockyard, MVP PARKING sign. A late-night Jason encounter around 02:39 reportedly triggers robot dolls; check the rear for Chastity and the reported Zombix pickup. Exact trigger unknown.\nRelationship tip: as Jason, approach the front passenger door when Lucia is with you; if Open for Lucia appears, hold Triangle/Y. A small relationship benefit is reported; no verified numerical gain.

Vice City coordinate-only leads: Elena’s Fruit Market (X -2886, Y 724) and Chihuahua Hotdogs in Balsero (X -2843, Y 719). Unconfirmed. These may overlap existing leads. Source map IDs are searchable in the README-linked directories; no new saved progress IDs.

Stick Ups: check Map > Robberies > Stick Ups before robbing a store for completion. A store can have a robbery card and estimated payout without counting toward the tracked list. Grassrivers Xero has reported branches at Capri and Watson Bay; Balsero RON also has multiple branches. Match the location, not just the store name. Hamlet Convenience Store and The Lock Box Gift Shoppe are unconfirmed leads.

Leonidex route numbers differ from other guide order. Compare map markers.
#1 Barnacle Beauties (50 m); #2 Crastenburg Hotel (50 m); #3 Street Art Squalo (20 m), Brian marina (100 m); #4 Carl Kasey (10 m); #5 Nudist Resort (70 m); #6 Jason house meditation (10 m); #7 Driveshaft Hustler (40 m); #8 VR Gamer (20 m); #9 Spiderweb Coquette (60 m).
#10 Riata and Maximus Goldbart (30 m); #11 Xavier Gomez and Southwind safe (50 m); #12 Mateo Caballero/water tower (140 m).
Distances are source-reported approximate nearest landmarks, not the hoop coordinates.

Confirm the item at shared map locations. At paired flamingo sites, use Focus to find the breakable figures and check the counter separately. Two reports at the Rusty Anchor may describe the same figure. Selkie Hole has five documented fragments; the nearby hotdog-site report is unconfirmed. Underwater helicopter wrecks, a submerged boat toilet and a submarine starboard seabed are separate reported search clues; do not assume every marker is a new fragment.

Ambergris Torlan (Calder, Blinged Up): look for a gold-hulled boat in a boathouse in Waning Sands, Leonard County.\nFlipside Enduro (Dinka, All-Terrain): reported shipping-container pickup at Mount Kalaga, Lummox County. Breakwater Quarry is associated with the Sandblasted Cliffhanger instead.\nBret's Rebel (Karin, All-Terrain): hunting reward from Killtelligence Provisions. The final Target Deck walkthrough reports it becomes available at the shop after Deck 15 if not already registered. Confirm each variant in WAiNK; these pickups have no separate checklist entries.

Patriot Cat: east Lummox near M7 operation, house with numerous cats; find flag-dyed cat sitting between two flags. Other cats and a card behind property; neighboring dogs may attack. Rainbow Poodle: central Vice City shopping-block sidewalk north of highway interchange, multicolor coat; screenshot-backed Nov 24 encounter. Unconfirmed. Use binoculars to study.

Video-indexed reports (VicePulse): Cottonmouth burned houses: left middle ruin, separate burnt house across river, blue paddling pool behind red house. These are cocaine-package reports, not proven flamingo counter entries. Gambit Bay: tree branch and ruined dock packages; do not count as flamingos without visible figure. Dawson Dam: Hillside Campsite southwest, reported meteorite. Compare existing crash camp ID 2512. Distinct item credit unverified.

Score at 90 of the 100 reported hoops for 100% completion. Check regional progress under Record > Activities > Sports > Basketball. Reported county totals: Vice-Dale 49; Mariana 18; Leonard 14; Kelly 14; Lummox 5. At Kelly airfield, look near Avery Allen & Co. Confirm the correct airfield before marking a hoop complete.

When following a flamingo route, destroy only breakable figures with black-and-white beaks. Cocaine package markers do not prove a flamingo is present. Some locations contain multiple figures; look around the entire site and check each destruction against the in-game counter. Use the category map and the pickup directions in Collections.

Beverly Gold: reported pickup on a small island in the northern Riquezas Keys, beside a lone chair. Watson Bay is an alternate report. Check the name and color when collected; some older guides call this card Dominant. Beverly Silver and Bronze are separate variants.

The following Other Animals variants have no confirmed encounter location: Baby Bonnet Cat, Bob-cut Maltese, Diva Poodle, Police Poodle, Pretty Pig, Snowbird Raccoon and Star-Spangled Raccoon. Use binoculars to confirm the exact animal name when encountered. Do not rely on a generic breed or habitat as a fixed spawn.

Reported game-text completion targets: Stick Ups 50; Cocaine Flamingos 100; Discovered Styles 70. These differ from reported full totals (91, 125, 79). Meteorite map totals differ between providers; use the in-game counter to distinguish independent fragments from alternate pins. A public map marker, candidate store or scan site does not necessarily represent a unique game collection slot.

For Illegal Operations, clear every key valuable shown on the map. The reported tracked roster contains 39 operations; ordinary bank robberies and the Ultimate Edition Illegal Goods Store are separate.\n\nBank jobs: Gibson Brothers, Fleeca Peacock Bay, Lombank Bayside, Fleeca Washington Beach and Druthers are listed as ordinary bank jobs in gameplay guides. Tequesta Fleeca is listed under Big Bank Jobs. Check the robbery category on the in-game map before starting.

Leonida Guide (Nov 25) documents 26 route stops. Extra comparison leads: Key Lento mailbox yard; island beach shack with solar panel; dune camp beside old pickup; Capri pier and stilt-house stairs; beach shack with green screen, open hut and beach-chair figure; Downtown marina park by Ferris wheel; vacant South Vice-Dale lot; green house fenced yard in Hamlet. Some are already represented by generic app leads; do not assign new IDs or count them separately until map and counter match. See linked illustrated route in README.

Key Lento: a reported west-shore blue house has an outdoor white stair, a fence and a stone pedestal; compare Brian Marina Workshop lead 3788 and GTADB western waterfront garden IG6_000820. Another report places a figure by a railing at a decorated purple-lit Surfside porch with a pink pool float; compare eccentric-house ID 1543 and stairs lead 3794. These may be old sites under new descriptions. Permit Keys: take a boat to the middle island and inspect beneath the sunflower-sign shack near the jetty; compare lead 5036. Do not add a checkmark solely for a new description.

Reported map directory: 17 named tattoo-magazine labels, including six paired labels (23 design names). These are not verified independent completion slots. See Collections for existing design checkmarks. Use WAiNK (hold D-pad Up, then R1 on PS5); verify the unlock under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Discovered Styles. A paired magazine may unlock both characters' designs from one scan.

Backyard Wrestler Belt & Luchadora — Hamlet backyard ring, floral sofa by B.A.M. banner.
Beached Cargo — Featherstone Islands, wade into the open blue container beside the Meerwunder; magazine by boxes on floor.
Circles of Hell Skull — Port Gellhorn Hellhole house, step near cooler.
Even Death Can't Part Us & One Life, One Love — reported lovers camp, yellow mat by heart pillow. Lucia One Life, One Love: back right leg, $1,710. Tracked as a shared pickup (2543).
Fairyland Forest Gnome — in the GTA Maps Leonida directory, open Style Magazines and select the exact label. November 27 guide identifies a disused camper beside the railroad near SR-37. Fairy Lane is a separate Curiosity (red miniature house); the 11:59 issue in Fairyland Forest is a reading collectible. Neither establishes the Gnome unlock. Tracked in Collections.
Glide or Die Hovercraft — north shore of the southernmost Sandbars island, north of Belpoint; magazine beside the wreck campsite lounge chairs.
Graffiti Point — Mount Kalaga fire-watch tower.
Home Street Home — trailer doorstep rug, Port Gellhorn.
Humanatee & Seductive Mermaid — northeast Catalan Key warehouse room.

Men From Mars & Women From Venus — west Ambrosia, Spaceship House at Cedar St and Maple Ln. Look on the ground in the yard by two folding chairs and a cooler; the controller may vibrate twice. Scan separately from the house curiosity. The midnight rooftop encounter is separate; a time restriction for the magazine is not established. Tracked in Collections.
Tee'd Off Dino — Ambrosia table; alternate batting-cage report east of Gellhorn.
The Bridge to Enlightenment — Historic Route 628 riverside bridge camp; tents and pallets. The unnamed bridge marker is reported 30 m from the named stop; do not assume separate credit.
The Freedom Raft — beach/raft site; compare Watson Bay and Permit Keys reports.
The Tower Tarot & The High Priestess Tarot — Hoffman Observatory mattress.
Vice City Monster Sculpture — reported camp beneath the Flamingo Parkway overpass where it leaves Atlantic Island toward Vice Beach; magazine on the ground beside the white plastic table near the concrete pillars. Tracked in Collections.
Wandering Cowboy & Wandering Cowgirl — Ambrosia abandoned church pew.
Zombie Deer (Jason) — Grayson, trigger two separate ghost-cat sightings near the bait and bike shops; an alternate report names Pay n Spray as a third possible spot. The meow alone reportedly counts, even if you miss seeing the cat. If the second sighting stalls, walk around the cemetery, try the office door, then sleep and return. At Benson Rentals northeast of bait shop, look for Stone Hill sign; enter open office and scan below table. The office also contains a readable ledger. Zombix is separate. Check Jason’s chest designs at a tattoo shop; price remains unknown. After the scan, follow the cat to the central cemetery altar for separate Curiosity credit. Focus (L3 + R3 on PS5) can help track it in the woods; lighting the final candle at night is a separate reported encounter. Tracked in Collections.

Stamped Tattoo remains in Collections: UV-zapper shack at Watson Bay/Leonida Bay, top of ramp; actual design unknown. The map also categorizes it as a hidden package. Paired unlocks may share a scan; check the actual counter before marking credit. All 17 reported magazine sites now have a checklist reference; paired designs and the unidentified Stamped Tattoo marker prevent a one-to-one count. Do not use the local checklist row count as the game's tattoo counter.

Reported game help: small carcasses fit in vehicle trunks; a pickup is not mandatory. As Jason, photograph large game at the carcass to request collection, then leave the area for payment. Wait if Bret is still processing a previous pickup. Boar and albino American alligator have explicit photo requests. Search for opossum and albino raccoon at night. Goose and white otter favor waterside areas.

Cal's reported catches include channel catfish (6 lb 2 oz), cobia (21 lb 1 oz) and permit (20 lb 2 oz); these weights are not confirmed challenge targets. Use medium freshwater lure for channel catfish and large saltwater lure for cobia and permit. Check the active fishing objective for the required species and weight.

Reported game help: protein after training halves recovery time. The anabolic window lasts one day; finish workouts within it. Sleep restores health and focus and temporarily improves stamina. Cardio options include gym treadmill, stationary bike and punching bag, plus outdoor running, swimming, cycling and kayaking. Gym access can depend on story or police restrictions. Ajax may be unavailable while Lucia is undercover.

Reported gym names and districts: Aichi (Washington Beach); Ajax (Catalan Bay); Dynamix (Bayside); Majestic Hotel (Tequesta); Venus (Ocean Beach); Vice Seven (Tequesta); Zenith (Downtown); Y Hotel (Washington Beach). Check available membership and access in game.

Find the artist 1010 post in Snapmatic. Stand on each marked viewpoint, open the phone camera and photograph the artwork; WAiNK scans do not count for this set. Three viewpoints are elevated, two are at street level. For Crosstown, wait for the painted train to stop. Check all five photos in Progress > Collections, then follow the reward clue to Southside Storage east of the airport beside Slator Towing. Enter 1010 for the custom Cheetah and reported free garage. This separate collection is not part of the 100 WAiNK scans.

At a pawn shop, open Collectible Cards to view the sell offer by set. The map price is the total of the collectibles held, not a guaranteed single-card value. A sold card remains visible in Progress, but verify the collection counter before selling a set if completion is your priority. The Silver Leroy Rook sale was reported at $6,000. The Gold variant was associated with an $8,500 total offer; its individual price is not confirmed by that screenshot.
